license_note: The author's original code is covered by the repository's CC0-1.0 dedication. The separately credited libraries remain MIT-licensed; the root CC0 LICENSE does not replace their licenses. Preserve the original headers and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt in redistributed builds.

adaptation.execution: Classic scripts in an isolated iframe, with a separate createjs namespace, one Pixi application and one animation tick for all actors.
adaptation.character_extract: The unchanged source text from function IteratedPeep(config) to the end of js/sims/Iterated.js is included. Its constructor, layered graphics, resetFace, update and kill interfaces are used; its playMove/PD/Q/audio paths are not called.
adaptation.splash_extract: The unchanged source text from function SplashPeep(config) to the end of js/sims/Splash.js is included. SplashPeep and SplashEdge provide the original opening's surrounding character network. The Splash application constructor, Loader manifest registration and original loading/audio paths are not started.
adaptation.new_logic: The adaptation supplies its own allocation, actor movement and money movement. It does not reuse the original Prisoner's Dilemma payoff rules or describe profit distribution as cooperate/cheat.
excluded: The original main.js startup and window.onload handler
The original Loader.js and its network/audio loading
The original Splash application constructor and its Loader manifest registration
The Iterated simulation constructor and payoff matrix
The original PD, strategy, tournament and population models
The original Q, Howler, Pegasus, sharing and other library startup paths
The original game slides, words.html, font and sound recordings
